Verifies Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 with the app secret and decodes replies (comment.received), mentions (mention.received), publish (post.published, with no owner ID), and delete (post.removed) deliveries. Answer the GET handshake with answerMetaWebhookChallenge.

ThreadsPublishOptions map reply controls, reply approvals, topic tags, quotes, polls, GIPHY GIFs, AI labels, spoilers, text attachments, ghost posts, location tags, geo-gating, and Instagram Story cross-sharing. locationId also needs threads_location_tagging; shareToInstagramStory also needs threads_share_to_instagram.
Threads publishing endpoints have no publish-time parameter; threads_publish publishes immediately.
Reads the authenticated profile's rolling 24-hour publishing quota from threads_publishing_limit. The response includes quota_usage and config.
Meta requires threads_manage_replies for reply_to_id. Replying to another user's post also needs that post to come from keyword search or mentions.
Hiding replies and pending-reply moderation require Threads reply-management permissions.
Deletes only replies published by the authenticated user. Threads allows 100 deletions per account per day. Use hideReply for other users' replies.
The Threads API has no endpoint to edit a published post; text and attachments are set when the container is created.
The Threads API exposes profile reads only. It has no profile write endpoint.
The profile endpoint reads the authorized app-scoped user; profile lookup requires threads_profile_discovery.
Threads has no profile search endpoint. Profile discovery only looks up an exact username, which profiles.read covers.
Threads does not expose follower or following lists. The followers_count metric is available through analytics.account.read.
Without threads_keyword_search approval, results are limited to the authorized user's posts.
Standard access returns posts from @meta, @threads, @instagram, and @facebook only; profiles need at least 100 followers.
Before threads_location_tagging approval, location_search only matches the query "Menlo Park". Meta allows 500 searches per 24 hours.
follower_demographics needs at least 100 followers and one breakdown.
debug_token accepts an app access token, or a Threads tester's user token, from the same app as the inspected token.
oEmbed needs no access token since March 3, 2026; the adapter still sends its own.
Threads does not expose messaging APIs to standard apps.
The Threads API has no notifications endpoint. Use mentions.read, reply reads, or webhooks instead.
Verifies the PubSubHubbub X-Hub-Signature for subscriptions created with hub.secret and decodes the Atom feed. Answer the GET verification with answerYouTubeWebhookChallenge.

Since 2026-11-02 YouTube no longer forces uploads from unverified API projects to private; channel settings can still default an upload to private. Upload completion and video processing are separate.
Scheduled videos are uploaded private with a future ISO publishAt timestamp.
Clears status.publishAt with videos.update and keeps the video private. The video is not deleted. Costs 51 quota units (videos.list + videos.update).
The YouTube Data API has no notifications resource. activities.list reports actions a channel took, not notifications it received.
Native access: updateProfile. Writes brandingSettings.channel or localizations through channels.update. Each call reads the channel (1 quota unit) and then writes it (50 units).
Uses search.list with type=video. Each page request costs 1 unit in a separate search quota bucket with a default limit of 100 calls per day.
comments.delete costs 50 quota units. Delete a thread through its top-level comment ID. Google does not document which comments a channel may delete; insufficient permissions return 403 forbidden.

Native access to liveChatMessages list, insert, delete, and closePoll (liveChatMessages.transition, 20 units). The YouTube authorization determines whether the caller may act on the selected chat; the adapter validates the supplied chat ID and body but cannot independently verify chat ownership.

Native liveChatStream: liveChatMessages.streamList over HTTP (GET /youtube/v3/liveChat/messages/stream, 5 units). Parses Google's streamed JSON-array framing; offline contract-tested only. Never reconnects; resume with nextPageToken.

Native access to liveChatModerators list, insert, and delete. The YouTube authorization determines whether the caller may moderate the selected chat; the adapter validates the supplied chat ID and body but cannot independently verify chat ownership.

Native access to liveChatBans insert and delete. YouTube does not expose a liveChatBans list or read method, so provider authorization is the ownership boundary for ban deletion. Ban bodies must follow the YouTube liveChatBan resource shape.
Channel sections are limited to ten shelves and updates replace the mutable parts supplied in the request.
Reads activities.list. Channel bulletins and activities.insert are deprecated and are not exposed.
Reports require an explicit bounded date range and provider-supported metrics.
Native analyticsGroups and analyticsGroupItems on the YouTube Analytics API (/v2/groups, /v2/groupItems). Filter reports with filters=group==ID.

Native reportTypes, reportingJobs, reports, and downloadReport on the YouTube Reporting API (youtubereporting.googleapis.com). Downloads are bounded by the caller's budget and only follow Reporting API media URLs.
Native uploadChannelBanner (channelBanners.insert, 50 units, 16:9, at most 6 MiB). Apply the returned url with updateProfile brandingSettings.image.bannerExternalUrl, which needs the youtube scope.
Native watermarks set (at most 10 MiB) and unset, 50 units each.
Native playlistImages list, insert, update, and delete: a square playlist thumbnail of at most 50 MB.
Native members and membershipsLevels. Only creators granted access through a Google or YouTube representative may call them, for their own memberships-enabled channel.

Native videos (videos.list by ID, chart=mostPopular, or myRating) and batchGetStats (videos.batchGetStats, its own 10,000-unit daily bucket). Reads any public video, not only the configured channel's.
Native channels: channels.list by ID, forHandle, or forUsername.
Native videoCategories and i18n (i18nLanguages.list, i18nRegions.list).
Native commentThreads: insert posts a top-level comment (50 units); list exposes searchTerms, order, textFormat, and moderationStatus including likelySpam.
Native commentReplies: comments.list with parentId.

Native reportAbuse (videos.reportAbuse, 50 units) with reason IDs from videoAbuseReportReasons. Native abuseReports calls the beta abuseReports.insert from the discovery document, which has no reference page.

The channel must have live streaming enabled in YouTube Studio. Native liveBroadcasts lists (by id, mine, or broadcastStatus, with broadcastType and paging), inserts, updates, deletes, binds, inserts ad cuepoints, and transitions broadcasts.
Native liveStreams list, insert, update, and delete. cdn.ingestionInfo contains the secret stream name.
Native superChatEvents: purchases from the channel's live streams in the last 30 days.
Verifies TikTok-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp and raw body) with the client secret and a 300 second default timestamp window, then decodes the event.

Content Posting API post_info has no publish-time field.

Requires video.publish for Direct Post or video.upload for inbox drafts.
The Content Posting API sets caption and privacy only when a post is initialized. It has no endpoint to edit a published post.
Standard Content Posting and Display APIs do not expose comments.
TikTok for Developers APIs do not expose a user notification inbox.
Reads the authorized creator only. Set userInfoProfile when user.info.profile was granted to add username, bio, profile link and verification.
The Display API reads user info only. TikTok has no profile write endpoint.
Professional accounts, public HTTPS media, explicit native continuation for processing containers. Carousels must have matching aspect ratios to avoid upstream cropping.
The content publishing API has no publish-time parameter; media_publish publishes immediately and unpublished containers expire after 24 hours.
Instagram Graph API does not provide an edit endpoint for published media.
Hide or unhide a comment, or enable or disable comments on media. Instagram Login and Facebook Login are supported where the account and app permissions qualify.
The IG User node supports reads only. Updating it is not supported.
Meta documents media deletion for Instagram API with Facebook Login only. See https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media
Meta documents media deletion for Instagram API with Facebook Login only. See https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media
Reads the paginated /{ig-user-id}/tags edge on graph.instagram.com. mentionedMedia and mentionedComment require Facebook Login. Story mentions and private media are not returned.
Product tagging is unavailable with Instagram Login.

Reads conversations with participants and messages with sender, recipients, text, timestamps, and attachments through GET /{ig-user-id}/conversations. The account must be a qualifying professional account and the app must have the required access level.

Reads the conversation participants and sends to the single participant other than this account through POST /{ig-user-id}/messages. Group, self-only, and unidentifiable conversations are rejected; use native.sendMessage with an explicit recipient ID for those.
Verifies Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 with the app secret and decodes object=instagram deliveries. Answer the GET handshake with answerMetaWebhookChallenge.
Meta documents /{ig-user-id}/likes for Instagram API with Facebook Login only.
The Instagram API has no notifications edge. Use mentions.read, tags, comments, or webhooks instead.

Explicit member author with public or connections visibility, annotations and reshare control. Requires w_member_social from Share on LinkedIn; no organization role is needed. Supports image, multi-image, video and document posts.
The Posts API accepts only lifecycleState PUBLISHED on creation and has no publish-time field.
Member post reads require the closed r_member_social grant, unavailable to new apps. Publication permission does not grant read permission.
Returns the configured member only. Reads the OpenID Connect userinfo endpoint and checks that sub matches the author URN. Requires the Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect product.
Publishes 2 to 20 registered images through posts.publish as organic MultiImage content. Every image must be owned by the author and AVAILABLE. Sponsored multi-image posts are not supported.

Upload one MP4 Blob (75 KB to 500 MB, 3 seconds to 30 minutes) with media.upload, then publish the video URN once it is AVAILABLE. Check processing with native videoStatus (one read) or the opt-in native waitForVideo (bounded reads within the operation budget). Publishing reads the status once and never waits; a processing video fails with no post created. The attachment caption becomes the optional video title.
One PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX file up to 100 MB and 300 pages, uploaded through the Documents API. LinkedIn enforces the page limit during processing. Requires a title and AVAILABLE status.
Native deleteComment needs the post URN and the complete commentUrn. LinkedIn does not document which comments an actor may delete; expect only the configured author's own comments to succeed.

Native uploadVideo uploads an MP4 like media.upload, plus an English SRT captions file and templateName/linkbackContext attribution (API version 202602+). A JPEG or PNG media.thumbnail Blob becomes the custom thumbnail on both paths.

Native subscribeOrganizationNotifications and unsubscribeOrganizationNotifications PUT and DELETE the eventSubscriptions key for the configured organization and one administrator. Needs an approved webhook use case, a validated webhook and an ADMINISTRATOR role; the subscription ends with that member's grant or role.

Native listOrganizationNotificationSubscriptions lists the authenticated member's subscriptions for the configured organization. Needs an approved webhook use case, a validated webhook and an ADMINISTRATOR role; the subscription ends with that member's grant or role.
Native getPosts sends BATCH_GET for up to 100 of the author's posts; native getPost reads one with viewContext READER or AUTHOR. LinkedIn does not allow BATCH_GET in the Development tier.
Native getSocialMetadata returns reactionSummaries per type, comment totals and commentsState. LinkedIn restricts member r_member_social_feed to select developers.
Native listReactions uses the q=entity finder with offset paging. LinkedIn restricts member r_member_social_feed to select developers.
Native listCommentReplies checks the parent comment belongs to the post, then lists its replies. LinkedIn restricts member r_member_social_feed to select developers.
Native deleteReaction removes the configured author's reaction.
Native setCommentsState sets commentsState OPEN or CLOSED. Closing deletes all existing comments.
Native createComment writes a top-level comment or nested reply with optional mentions and one image, without pre-reading the post.
Native editComment replaces message text and mention attributes.
Requires the Community Management API product and organization administrator access. Member accounts are not eligible.

Publishes an article-link post through the Posts API. LinkedIn does not scrape article URLs; title and description are required by this adapter. The LinkedIn articleThumbnail option sends an uploaded image URN as the thumbnail.
Member profile writes use the Profile Edit API, which LinkedIn restricts to approved developers. This adapter does not implement it.
LinkedIn has a restricted partner Messages API. This adapter implements no message send method.

LinkedIn enables webhooks only for apps with an approved webhook use case. Organization social action notifications also need the Community Management API and an organization administrator. Verifies X-LI-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 over hmacsha256= plus the raw body) with the app client secret; answer the GET validation with answerLinkedInWebhookChallenge.

Organization social-action notifications from the last 60 days, pulled with offset paging; native listOrganizationNotifications adds action, sourcePost and timeRange filters. Requires the Community Management API product and organization administrator access. LinkedIn has no member notification API.
LinkedIn does not expose a seen or read state for notifications.
Lifetime follower count for the configured member from memberFollowersCount (q=me). Requires the Community Management r_member_profileAnalytics scope.
Native getMemberPostAnalytics (memberCreatorPostAnalytics) and getMemberVideoAnalytics (memberCreatorVideoAnalytics) for the configured member. Organization accounts are not eligible.
Native getMemberFollowerCount reads memberFollowersCount, lifetime or daily within a dateRange.
Native getBrandPageStatistics reads brandPageStatistics for the configured organization as a showcase page. Requires an ADMINISTRATOR role.
Native getOrganizationPostStatistics reads lifetime share statistics for specific posts with shares=List(...) and ugcPosts=List(...). Requires an ADMINISTRATOR role.
Native listOrganizationRoles uses the organizationAcls organization finder for the configured organization. Requires an ADMINISTRATOR role.

Native lookupOrganizations (organizationsLookup), findOrganizationByVanityName (q=vanityName) and listOrganizationBrands (q=parentOrganization). Lookups return non-admin fields; brand discovery returns only brands the member administers.

Native getSocialMetadataBatch (socialMetadata?ids=List), getSocialActionsBatch (socialActions?ids=List) and getComments (comments?ids=List) read up to 100 posts or comments per request. LinkedIn restricts member r_member_social_feed to select developers.
Native getReaction reads one reaction by (actor, entity) and returns undefined on 404; getReactions batch gets up to 100 keys. LinkedIn restricts member r_member_social_feed to select developers.
Native mediaStatuses reads up to 100 of the author's images, videos and documents with one images?ids=List, videos?ids=List or documents?ids=List request per type. Scopes match media.read.

Native createEvent (POST /rest/events), updateEvent (partial update while upcoming), uploadEventBackgroundImage (assets registerUpload) and createEventPost (content.reference). Delete an event by deleting its ugcPost with deletePost. LinkedIn grants the Events API separately from the Marketing API program; organization organizers need an ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.

Native getEvent and listEvents (q=eventsByOrganizer with excludeCancelled, timeBasedFilter, entryCriteria and sortOrder). Events are readable only after they are posted. LinkedIn grants the Events API separately from the Marketing API program; organization organizers need an ADMINISTRATOR or CONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR role.

Native getOrganizationVideoAnalytics reads videoAnalytics (VIDEO_VIEW, VIEWER, TIME_WATCHED, TIME_WATCHED_FOR_VIDEO_VIEWS) for one ugcPost video with DAY, WEEK or ALL aggregation and an optional timeRange. Member accounts use getMemberVideoAnalytics.

Native getOrganizationAuthorization, getOrganizationAuthorizations (BATCH_GET) and findOrganizationAuthorizations (bq=authorizationActionsAndImpersonator) ask LinkedIn whether a member may take an action, such as ORGANIC_SHARE_CREATE or UPDATE_ANALYTICS_READ, for an organization.

Native getProfile (GET /v2/me, member authors only) and getPeople (GET /v2/people/(id:...) or /v2/people?ids=List(...), up to 50) with optional projections. LinkedIn restricts the Profile API to approved developers; r_basicprofile adds headline and vanityName. Store other members' profile data only as LinkedIn's terms allow.

Native resolveMemberVanityUrl maps a follower's profile URL to a person URN with vanityUrl q=vanityUrlAsOrganization. LinkedIn restricts the People Typeahead endpoints to select developers; keyword search (peopleTypeahead) is not implemented.

9:16 video, 3 to 90 seconds, from a hosted URL or uploaded bytes, through the three-phase Page Reels API. Meta allows 30 API-published Reels per Page in a moving 24 hours window, and the adapter refuses a Reel past that count in one process.

Messenger conversations (platform=messenger) with participants, and message details, which Meta returns for the 20 most recent messages of a conversation.
